mapper.sql: JOIN project_config p ON p.id = s.project_id AND p.del_flag = 3 JOIN project_version_config pv ON pv.id = s.version_id AND pv.project_id = s.project_id AND pv.del_flag = 3 JOIN project_module_config pm ON pm.id = s.module_id AND pm.project_id = s.project_id AND pm.version_id = s.version_id AND pm.del_flag = 3

s.id AS scene_db_id, s.scene_id AS scene_key, s.name, s.description, s.project_id AS project_db_id, p.name AS project_name, s.version_id AS version_db_id, pv.name AS version_name, s.module_id AS module_db_id, pm.path AS module_path, s.level, s.status, s.tags, COALESCE(s.definition_version, 0) AS definition_version, COALESCE(es.execution_revision, 0) AS global_execution_revision, COALESCE(cu.nickname, '-') AS create_user_string, COALESCE(uu.nickname, '-') AS update_user_string, s.create_time, s.update_time
mapper.select:
SELECT s.project_id FROM automation_ui_scene s
WHERE s.id = #{sceneDbId} AND s.del_flag = 3
LIMIT 1

SELECT s.id FROM automation_ui_scene s
WHERE (s.scene_id = #{sceneKey} OR CAST(s.id AS CHAR) = #{sceneKey}) AND s.del_flag = 3
ORDER BY CASE WHEN s.scene_id = #{sceneKey} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM automation_ui_scene s
WHERE s.del_flag = 3

SELECT FROM automation_ui_scene s
LEFT JOIN automation_ui_scene_execution_state es ON es.scene_id = s.id LEFT JOIN sys_user cu ON cu.id = s.create_user LEFT JOIN sys_user uu ON uu.id = s.update_user WHERE s.del_flag = 3
ORDER BY
s.id s.name s.update_time s.create_time
ASC DESC , s.id
ASC DESC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM automation_ui_scene s
WHERE s.del_flag = 3

SELECT FROM automation_ui_scene s
LEFT JOIN automation_ui_scene_execution_state es ON es.scene_id = s.id LEFT JOIN sys_user cu ON cu.id = s.create_user LEFT JOIN sys_user uu ON uu.id = s.update_user
WHERE s.del_flag = 3
ORDER BY
s.id s.name s.update_time s.create_time
ASC DESC , s.id
ASC DESC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT FROM automation_ui_scene s
LEFT JOIN automation_ui_scene_execution_state es ON es.scene_id = s.id LEFT JOIN sys_user cu ON cu.id = s.create_user LEFT JOIN sys_user uu ON uu.id = s.update_user WHERE s.del_flag = 3 AND s.id IN
#{sceneDbId}
ORDER BY s.id

SELECT s.id AS scene_db_id, COALESCE(es.execution_revision, 0) AS global_execution_revision, es.update_time FROM automation_ui_scene s
LEFT JOIN automation_ui_scene_execution_state es ON es.scene_id = s.id WHERE s.del_flag = 3 AND s.id IN
#{sceneDbId}
ORDER BY s.id

SELECT s.id AS scene_db_id, s.scene_id AS scene_key, s.name, s.description, s.project_id AS project_db_id, p.name AS project_name, s.version_id AS version_db_id, pv.name AS version_name, s.module_id AS module_db_id, pm.path AS module_path, s.level, s.status, s.tags, COALESCE(s.definition_version, 0) AS definition_version, s.definition_size_bytes AS definition_bytes, s.definition_step_count AS definition_step_count FROM automation_ui_scene s
WHERE s.id = #{sceneDbId} AND s.del_flag = 3

SELECT rs.published_projection_id, rs.definition_version, rs.source_sha256, rs.status, rs.case_count, rs.step_count, rs.build_token, (rs.next_retry_at IS NOT NULL) AS retryable, rs.last_error FROM automation_ui_scene s
JOIN automation_ui_scene_definition_read_state rs ON rs.scene_id = s.id AND rs.definition_version = COALESCE(s.definition_version, 0) WHERE s.id = #{sceneDbId} AND s.del_flag = 3
mapper.sql:
JOIN automation_ui_scene s ON s.id = #{sceneDbId} AND s.id = c.scene_id
JOIN automation_ui_scene_definition_read_state rs ON rs.scene_id = s.id AND rs.definition_version = COALESCE(s.definition_version, 0) AND rs.status = 'ready' AND rs.published_projection_id = #{projectionId} WHERE s.id = #{sceneDbId} AND s.del_flag = 3 AND COALESCE(s.definition_version, 0) = #{definitionVersion}

JOIN automation_ui_scene s ON s.id = #{sceneDbId} AND s.id = st.scene_id
JOIN automation_ui_scene_definition_read_state rs ON rs.scene_id = s.id AND rs.definition_version = COALESCE(s.definition_version, 0) AND rs.status = 'ready' AND rs.published_projection_id = #{projectionId} WHERE s.id = #{sceneDbId} AND s.del_flag = 3 AND COALESCE(s.definition_version, 0) = #{definitionVersion}
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM automation_ui_scene_definition_case_read c
AND c.projection_id = rs.published_projection_id
AND (c.case_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '\\' OR c.case_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '\\')

SELECT c.id, c.case_id, c.case_index, c.case_name, c.step_count, CAST(c.case_json AS CHAR) AS case_json, c.node_sha256 FROM automation_ui_scene_definition_case_read c
AND c.projection_id = rs.published_projection_id
AND (c.case_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '\\' OR c.case_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '\\')
ORDER BY c.case_index, c.id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT c.id, c.case_id, c.case_index, c.case_name, c.step_count, CAST(c.case_json AS CHAR) AS case_json, c.node_sha256 FROM automation_ui_scene_definition_case_read c
AND c.projection_id = rs.published_projection_id AND c.case_id = #{caseId} LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM automation_ui_scene_definition_step_read st
AND st.projection_id = rs.published_projection_id AND st.case_id = #{caseId}

SELECT st.id, st.case_id, st.step_id, st.step_index, CAST(st.step_json AS CHAR) AS step_json, st.node_sha256 FROM automation_ui_scene_definition_step_read st
AND st.projection_id = rs.published_projection_id AND st.case_id = #{caseId} AND st.step_id = #{stepId} LIMIT 1
